settings.advancedApiTimeoutHint: Time limit for one non-streaming request to the engine (10-1800 seconds). The streaming path keeps its own bounds (300 s read) and is untouched by this field.
settings.advancedFilmSfxDirHint: A folder of your own .wav files that the film studio resolves by name. The EPHE_SFX_DIR environment variable takes precedence when it is set.
settings.advancedPublicTunnelIdleMinutesHint: How long a public tunnel stands without a request from the phone (5-240 minutes); then Ephe closes it and the public address is gone. A phone in use moves the boundary.
settings.appearanceAccentHint: Chooses the curated accent for the mark and live actions; grounds, status tones and selection stay unchanged.
settings.appearanceAnimationsEnabledHint: Turns transitions and CSS animations on or off; off also stills the spring entrance of messages and the companion's sounds. The operating system's reduced-motion keeps applying on top.
settings.appearanceBaseFontPxHint: Base step in px (13, 14 or 15); the percentage dials scale it.
settings.appearanceChatFontScaleHint: Scales only the conversation text between 80 and 150 percent; the rest of the interface keeps following the general font scale.
settings.appearanceCompanionBehaviorHint: Sets place and motion: flying and clickable at the composer, sitting calmly at the input, resting in the header next to the mark, or only on the welcome screen after the first chat. On the welcome screen the figure always stands.
settings.appearanceCompanionBehaviorOptionHeader: Calm in the header next to the mark
settings.appearanceCompanionCountdownSecondsHint: Time before it acts (0-10 s); at 0 it acts at once.
settings.appearanceCompanionEnabledHint: Shows the chosen companion on the welcome screen and in the active chat. Off hides it everywhere while form, size and sound choices stay stored and return the next time it is switched on.
settings.appearanceCompanionModeHint: Chooses the companion's work: sit quietly at the edge, point at targets on the surface, or act as a co-pilot that runs safe actions itself after a visible countdown. Riskier actions always stay with the user.
settings.appearanceCompanionScaleHint: Scales the companion alone (70-140 percent); type, spacing and touch targets stay.
settings.appearanceCompanionSoundHint: Turns the wing flutter and the spark's crystal note on or off. The system's reduced-motion setting and the animations switch keep the synthesizer silent as well, whatever this switch says.
settings.appearanceCompanionSpeciesHint: Chooses the form in the workspace: the folded paper moth, the golden spark with ghost eyes from the film, or a calm emblem. The moth carries wings and a gaze; the spark is a glow with two eyes.
settings.appearanceFontScaleHint: Scales the interface text in percent around the chosen base text size (80-150 percent); rem spacing stays. Applies right after saving.
settings.appearanceReadingWidthHint: Caps the conversation width between 480 and 1200 pixels; on narrow windows the available width stays the limit.
settings.appearanceShowTimestampsHint: Shows the time under each message. Off hides only that line; content, tool trail and buttons stay put.
settings.appearanceUpdateChannelHint: Release: published tags only; the signed app and the PWA move with them. Commit: every green merge from main — the backend and PWA follow, the desktop shell only at the next release. The terminal stays on releases.
settings.appearanceUpdateCheckHint: Polls the GitHub releases anonymously every 30 minutes and then shows the update banner. Off: no outbound request, no banner.
settings.chatAllowInputWhileStreamingHint: On: Enter queues another task while Ephe answers. Off: the composer is read-only during a turn and Enter does nothing.
settings.chatContinueAttemptsHint: How often Ephe nudges an answer that announces a step but never runs it (0-5). At 0 the stop stands and no extra model round is started.
settings.chatDetailsModeHint: Starting state of a finished turn: expanded shows the whole timeline (reasoning, tools, answer) and the millisecond readout; collapsed the answer with the plain check sentence in seconds. A click on the head overrides it for that turn.
settings.chatDurationFormatHint: How long something took: compact per Ephe norm (4m 12s, at most two units) or as a clock (04:12, 1:04:12 past an hour). Applies to the turn head, the durations of the panels and the memory row; the thinking line stays terse.
settings.chatExpandToolCallsHint: The top tool group of a turn starts open instead of closed. Your own click always wins — the default holds until the first click on a line.
settings.chatShowReasoningHint: Shows the model's reasoning as its own line — at its position in the timeline, first in the legacy layout. Off hides only the reasoning text; tools and the answer stay.
settings.chatShowThinkingLoaderHint: The pulsing “thinking…” line with its ticking seconds while the phase runs. Off drops only that line; the reasoning text follows “Show reasoning”.
settings.chatShowToolCountHint: Shows after a tool group how often it was called — live as done/total, finished as a number; a single call shows no number. Off hides only that counter; the line stays.
settings.chatStreamIdleSecondsHint: Aborts a running stream when the server sends no byte for this long (10-600 seconds). Only silence counts, not total duration — a long answer is left alone.
settings.chatToolResultCharsHint: How many characters a tool result may carry before it is shortened into the conversation context (2,000-120,000). Low saves room in long tool chains, high keeps more of the file or shell output.
settings.cronHistoryKeepHint: How many runs are kept — in memory and in schedule_results.json (10-500). Oldest go first; export anything you need before it drops.
settings.cronHistoryRowsHint: How many runs the list under a schedule shows (5-100). Changes nothing about what is stored — only what is visible.
settings.cronMaxParallelJobsHint: How many runs of the same job may overlap (1-10). At 1, the default, a slot that falls into a run still going is skipped and does not catch up.
settings.cronMisfireGraceMinutesHint: How long a one-shot may still start after its time when Ephe was not running (0-1440 minutes); 0 never catches up and past the window the run lapses. Recurring slots always wait for their next time.
settings.ephemeraEvaporateOnDeleteHint: Whether deleting a session in the app also frees its work directory at once instead of waiting for the idle limit; the API delete, the clear and retention wait it out. Files a run wrote to the output folder stay — no switch deletes them.
settings.ephemeraIdleTtlMinutesHint: How long a cell survives without a run (5-240 minutes); the next access discards it and its namespace is gone. Only a run moves the boundary. A new value applies to the next cell built.
settings.ephemeraTrashRetentionDaysHint: How long a deleted task waits in the trash before Ephe deletes it for good. 0-365 days; 0 keeps everything until you empty the trash yourself. The clock starts at the delete; every run the sweep takes leaves one line in the log.
settings.generationContextWindowHint: Context window Ephe assumes for this model: caps how much history and tool text fit into the request. Unset falls back to the model table.
settings.generationMaxTokensHint: Upper bound of tokens per answer. Empty lets the engine decide; a set value caps every response.
settings.generationMemoryMaxEntriesHint: Ceiling for stored memory entries. Above it, auto-memory evicts the least valuable self-learned ones, at most 50 per pass.
settings.generationSwarmMaxParallelHint: How many swarm agents of one wave may run at the same time (1 = one after another). The rest queue up until a slot frees.
settings.generationTemperatureHint: How random the wording gets: 0 pins the engine to the most likely token, higher values vary more. Sent with every request; 0.0 is the deliberate default here because eval runs need repeatability.
settings.generationToolBudgetHint: How many tool calls one turn may make at most (1-40). It stops the agent loop, not the model. Unset keeps the class default: 25 rounds, /ephe up to the cap of 40.
settings.generationTopPHint: Nucleus sampling: admits only the most probable mass up to this value. Empty lets the engine decide; set, it ships with every request.
settings.hooksEnabledHint: Off runs none of the commands in hooks.json — no subprocess before or after a tool call. The file stays as it is; tools and answers keep running unchanged.
settings.memoryCaptureEnabledHint: After each answer, decide whether the pair is worth keeping and store it. Off: no new facts are added — search, injection and the memory tool keep working.
settings.memoryCaptureMinAnswerCharsHint: Below this length an answer is too thin to become a memory (20-2000 characters); the question itself needs at least 8 characters. Someone who explicitly asks Ephe to keep it passes the answer bound.
settings.memoryDedupeScoreThresholdHint: From which similarity (0.5 to 1) a hit counts as a duplicate and the new pair is not stored. The check reads the 8 closest hits from the question's first 200 characters, over Ephe's own entries only; an identical text can score below it.
settings.memoryEmbedderAllowDownloadHint: Allows the automatic fetch of the EmbeddingGemma weights (542 MB) from huggingface.co into the device folder. The popup's button fetches once as its own consent without this switch; without weights the vector arm stays off.
settings.memoryEmbedderHint: EmbeddingGemma 2 emits 768 values, Ephe stores the leading 256; all-MiniLM-L6-v2 stays at 384. A switch applies from the next stored entry; the other model's rows return to the search after the re-embed run.
settings.memoryInjectMaxEntriesHint: At most how many entries are lifted into the system prompt (1-50) — the same number bounds injection's own search. More knowledge, more tokens.
settings.memoryInjectMinScoreHint: Below this value (0 to 1) a found entry is not injected, because it would only cost tokens. Higher keeps the block leaner, lower lets more through.
settings.pluginsPluginAutorunHint: Applies at install time only: a new plugin lands enabled in the registry, a bundled or verified pack always; with the plugin switches read-only nothing lands on. Existing entries stay as they are.
settings.pluginsPluginSignatureCheckHint: Checks on enable whether the plugin content still matches its stored signature; on drift the activation fails with 409 and an audit entry. Installation is checked independently.
settings.shortcutsGlobalEnabledHint: The one switch that claims a key outside the window: Cmd+Shift+E on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+E elsewhere, brings Ephe to the front. Off is the default; if another app owns the chord, Ephe writes the value back to off.
settings.solEnabled: Learn from failures in this project
settings.solEnabledHint: After a failed round Ephe names the class, the broken assumption and the correction for the next request. A correction that ended the run becomes a readable rule under .ephe/learning/; this switch turns both off.
settings.solMaxActiveRulesHint: How many learned project rules ride along in the prompt (5-50). Older rules move to heuristics-archive.md; none is deleted, and the file stays editable by hand.
